thread:
eve: Quick FYI — during the SDK snippet migration I found the 429 example in docs/error-reference is outdated. It shows immediate retries which can multiply spikes.

sam: Which file/path?

eve: docs/error-reference/429-behavior.md. The curl example ignores Retry-After and our X-Redwood-Retry hint; no context-trim fallback documented.

tony: Good catch. We should include a compact set: 1) curl dev-check that prefers Retry-After, 2) tiny SDK patterns (py/js/go) that prefer Retry-After -> X-Redwood-Retry -> exp+jitter, 3) a short context-salvage example and streaming guidance.

eve: I'll draft the minimal snippets and a short QA repro script. Keep them <20 lines each so they stay in sync across SDKs.

sam: Key rules to call out: prefer server Retry-After if present; else use X-Redwood-Retry hint; else exponential backoff with jitter. Normalize values <1s to 1s, add +/-30% jitter, cap retries (e.g., 5) then trip circuit-breaker.

tony: For streaming: if stream interrupted with 429, reconnect with backoff and resume partial context where safe; avoid blind resends of full prompt. Also log partial outputs and reason codes.

eve: Draft Python pseudocode (very short) and a brittle curl one-liner for dev checks. I'll also add a short "migration notes" block telling maintainers to update docs/sdk-snippets/* for parity.

sam: Please add a one-paragraph "what changed" for the release notes and a changelog line. That helps the docs digest editors.

eve: Will do. Opening PR targeting docs/error-reference/429-behavior.md and adding files under docs/sdk-snippets/python,js,go/429_examples. Title: "429: prefer Retry-After and graceful fallbacks (snippets + migration)". Requesting reviews from @sam and @tony.

docs-bot: PR created by eve: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012  Labels: docs, 429-playbook, needs-approval.

qa-bot: QA plan appended in PR: run the provided burst repro against a sandbox route, validate that Retry-After is present, client respects header before retry, circuit trips after capped attempts, and that context-salvage reduces payload size and succeeds at a lower rate.

deploy-bot: staging docs preview build queued (build #12600).

sam: Approved with a small wording nit: avoid "always" when describing Retry-After. It's authoritative when present but behavior differs by proxy. Pushed a tiny edit.

tony: LGTM, merging after the edit.

docs-bot: PR merged by tony. Preview published at https://docs-preview.redwood.com/429-playbook-migration.

eve: I'll follow up with a changelog snippet and add a cross-link from the troubleshooting hub to this playbook.

sam: Resolved for me. Thanks all.

tony: Closing thread.
